verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
WULIRA-eddoboozi
Erijja gy'oli
Genda Yesu gy'ali
Akugamba nti:

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Mpa omutima gwo,
Nnakufiirira,
Nze,nze nkuyita ggwe,
Sembera gye ndi

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Eddoboozi ttono
Naye lya maanyi;
Laba-okwagala kwe,
Ggwe omwonoonyi.

verse.name: v5
verse.lines:
Muwe omwoyo gwo
Yakufiirira;
Ye akuyita ggwe,
Genda mangu nnyo.
